description: Chicken stir-fry. The sauce components (soy/fish sauce, chili oil, cornstarch) are attributed to the whisking step where they are measured; the later 'pour in the sauce' step does NOT re-list them (they are already combined in a bowl). Also stresses 'oil' false positives across three different oils.
steps: Whisk the soy sauce, fish sauce, chili oil, and cornstarch in a bowl to make the sauce.
Heat the vegetable oil in a wok over high heat.
Add the chicken and stir-fry until browned, then remove.
Add the bell pepper and snap peas and stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Add the garlic and ginger and toss until fragrant.
Return the chicken, pour in the sauce, and toss until glossy.
Drizzle with sesame oil, top with green onions, and serve.
